text_source: documents.jsonl, truncated at text_chars_cap=4000 (the text the model saw)
entity_metric_note: string-based surface-form agreement, NOT semantic entity F1
entity_precision_caveat: gold contains only ATT&CK-typed objects, so any other entity the text genuinely mentions is scored as a false positive; the entity precision/F1 here is a lower bound and must not be quoted as extraction precision

interval95.based_on: relation_scored_only (types with at least one gold instance)

relation_unscored.reason: gold has zero instances of this type -- every prediction of it was counted as a false positive in relation_micro. It is neither credited nor debited here, and it is NOT evidence that the model is wrong about it

relation_precision_caveat: gold is built by requiring the relation TARGET's name to appear verbatim inside the capped document text (the same window the model saw), so a prediction linking two real entities whose target is not spelled out in that window is scored as a false positive. Precision is therefore a LOWER BOUND; recall is unaffected by this and remains the measure that can be defended.
entity_gold_construction: verbatim substring match of ATT&CK object names/aliases

gate.applied_to: relation_micro, i.e. the 4 of 17 schema relation types that map to a curated ATT&CK relationship (attributed-to, part-of, targets, uses), over 120 of 649 extracted documents, with 42 gold instances. It is NOT a statement about extraction quality in general.

evaluability.note: v2 §2.3: with 42 gold instances one hit is worth 2.4 points of recall; the threshold 0.8 is carried from pre-registration and is NOT lowered here. Whether it is attainable at this gold size is reported as an interval rather than asserted either way.

gate.name: relation_gate
gate.market_edges_status: UNVALIDATED_RELATION (excluded from gate; flagged in graph)

entity_gate.reason: plan §5.1 asks for entity F1 as well; there is no semantic entity gold set, and surface-form agreement is not F1. The gate covers relations only and must not be read as an overall PASS.
